progressRule: Only accepted real-task outcomes O1-O5 in a currently valid authority graph with G1-G4 passing count as progress. Every O1-O5 registration binds the acceptance-owned environment contract, one committed task-relevant starting manifest and authority-and-available-source envelope, one environment class and treatment arm, the exact Harness activation delta if present, and one privacy-safe pre-response source-capture resolution. Each task-host unit runs once in its pre-registered arm; O5 cross-host execution is required portability replication, not a same-host replay, and Harness-specific value claims remain no stronger than prospective same-environment matched observational evidence. Observed-native-minimum and user-configured are starting conditions rather than static capability ceilings: after demand, the Agent may adapt capabilities, configuration, models, providers and online or local execution only through current source resolution, minimum-sufficient routing, bounded authority, attributed lifecycle deltas, verification, rollback and cleanup. Before any task measurement, a new content-addressed profile and cohort protocol must be frozen and independently source-authorized under the current environment contract. Before model processing, every submitted source event on the active enrollment surface must receive a privacy-safe private capture and a pending resolution identity; before outcome-bearing execution or completion, that event must resolve to an immutable eligible-task registration or a narrow source-bound exclusion. Missing capture, unresolved eligibility, user-visible outcome text before the host completion barrier, uncontained hosted-tool bypass, late registration or omitted earlier demand stops the affected cohort rather than becoming a retrospective exclusion. The realized cohort is the earliest eligible natural-demand prefix, failures remain in place, public identities are unlinkable random identifiers, and source validators privately prove complete windows, chronology, deduplication, environment identity and criterion semantics. v1.0 and v1.1 profile, cohort, authorization, registration, outcome and ordering state are immutable stopped history and cannot be reused. Even after O1-O5 evidence passes, completionState remains in-progress until the code-owned terminal release gate verifies the clean exact candidate, predeclared O5 evidence set, named-human authorization, identical public annotated tag object and peeled commit, and empty ignored and untracked residue. Documents, tests, inventories, fixtures, research volume, prior-release evidence and environment manifests remain supporting inputs only.

environmentAttribution.scope: all O1-O5 registrations, measurements, comparisons, adapter claims and release evidence
environmentAttribution.assignmentRule: each natural task-host execution unit runs once in one pre-registered arm; no same-host treatment replay merely for measurement, O5 cross-host replication is pre-registered portability evidence, and a paired baseline must be a pre-registered comparable historical or independent natural task
environmentAttribution.comparisonRule: compare only pre-registered matched tasks within the same environment class, fixed task-relevant starting manifest and initial authority-and-available-source envelope; exact Harness package and activation identity is the only planned initial route and configuration difference, while later capability and configuration changes are attributed treatment-mediated lifecycle deltas; unavoidable task differences remain explicit matching variables, the evidence is prospective matched observational rather than single-variable causal, and cross-class differences cannot be claimed as Harness effects
environmentAttribution.initialStateRule: the committed pre-task manifest and initial authority-and-available-source envelope define the starting condition, not a static capability ceiling; task-time Agent-selected or human-authorized changes are recorded as treatment-mediated lifecycle deltas rather than erased, normalized away or mislabeled as baseline contamination
environmentAttribution.observedNativeMinimumRule: exclude discoverable user-global instructions, configuration, rules, Skills, plugins, Apps, MCP, Hooks, memory and provider overrides at the starting boundary; task-inherent project guidance is allowed only when identical and non-Harness in both arms; system, developer, built-in, account, administrator and unobservable state is retained-or-unknown; after demand, governed task-time adaptation remains allowed and attributable
environmentAttribution.userConfiguredRule: freeze the actual task-relevant user starting environment before assignment; after demand, governed task-time adaptation remains allowed and attributable; mutable, unresolved, unavailable or drifting starting components narrow the claim or stop the pair and cannot be normalized away after observing a result
environmentAttribution.neutralWorkspaceRule: a without-Harness baseline cannot inherit Harness repository guidance, adapters or consumer projection; use a neutral workspace or the real target repository with identical task-inherent non-Harness guidance in both arms
environmentAttribution.taskTimeAdaptationRule: after demand reveals need, the Agent uses a healthy already-authorized route or, before execution, binds an immutable decision record covering the residual gap, current source resolution, authority class, planned lifecycle action, rollback and cleanup; online AI is the normal route, while local, edge or offline execution is a demand-triggered minimum-sufficient degradation or data-locality route rather than a mandatory product line, and recovery to an online route is reconciled and attributed; the Agent performs every supported authorized mechanic, while a technically or authoritatively human-only action is reduced to the smallest exact step, explained without requiring route knowledge, and verified before resuming
environmentAttribution.versionResolutionRule: at each decision resolve the current suitable official or maintained source from a bounded as-of source and bind the exact version, commit or package identity before acquisition or execution; use current evidence, not one historical version across tasks, never execute an unresolved mutable label such as latest, and on material mid-execution drift re-register or honestly stop
environmentAttribution.lifecycleRule: retain, install, configure, enable, use, switch between online and local or edge execution, degrade, restore, disable, downgrade, rollback, retire or persist a route only by current need, evidence and authority; preserve the same quality, privacy, safety, evidence and human-authority floors across route changes, end task-scoped exposure when the need ends unless persistence has separate net-value evidence and authorization, then verify the final or restored state and cleanup
environmentAttribution.humanInterventionRule: distinguish a technically or authoritatively unavoidable human-only decision or host action from a prohibited transfer of Agent-owned work; the former must be source-bound, minimal, explicitly guided and post-verified, while the user never has to discover or name the route, configuration variable, syntax, recovery or cleanup and the Agent performs every supported authorized mechanic
environmentAttribution.burdenRule: record all human actions and round trips in total burden, classify legitimate human-only actions separately from prohibited Agent-work transfers, require zero prohibited transfers, and do not hide excessive or avoidable human-only interaction from O2 comparison
environmentAttribution.historicalEvidenceRule: classify every reused historical item as environment-independent, environment-bound or invalidated; no prior outcome, cohort membership or environment assumption is inherited
environmentAttribution.driftRule: missing starting identity, mutable unbound dependencies, unknown material contamination, unregistered lifecycle drift or restoration failure stops the affected pair without replacement or success imputation; an official update between tasks is re-resolved and rebound rather than treated as permanent version drift
environmentAttribution.humanAuthority: The user authorizes access to private configuration or authentication state, protected backup, reset or restoration, a new OS account or trust boundary, installation, publication and irreversible effects, and performs a technically or authoritatively unavoidable host action only under minimal exact Agent guidance; the Agent owns need detection, recommendation, every supported authorized mechanic, post-action verification, restoration verification and exact cleanup.

criteria.name: sustained goal-level autonomous delivery
criteria.statement: A finite environment-stratified cohort of natural real tasks reaches named-human-accepted outcomes from goal-level demand while the Agent owns intent completion, capability and task-carrier choice, recovery, verification, release and cleanup mechanics.
criteria.metric: accepted natural tasks with zero prohibited transfers of Agent-owned capability, code-or-conversation-topology, context-reconstruction, recovery, verification, release-mechanics or cleanup work; legitimate human-only decisions and host actions are separately recorded, minimized, guided and verified; material collaboration-loss events remain zero
criteria.threshold: at least six materially different accepted with-exact-harness tasks covering new intake from a user with no Harness, Codex-tooling or capability-route knowledge, existing-project continuation, long-context work, a residual capability gap, a consequential human gate, and an honest failure-or-recovery path; at least two tasks are measured under observed-native-minimum and at least two under user-configured, at least two tasks are outside Harness repository dogfooding, at least one outside-Harness task runs through the final reference adapter and is cross-bound into O5, and no task may be invented, replayed or reassigned to exercise the Harness

operationalization.sampleUnit: one goal-level natural task with immutable registration and task-bound result validation
operationalization.passRule: Every registered task uses the current program-frozen normative profile, prospective cohort protocol, independently source-authorized enrollment activation and acceptance-owned environment attribution binding; its task-specific validator proves a natural-demand event after authorized activation and before registration, a complete continuous source-native cursor window with no omitted earlier eligible demand, deduplication, a fixed pre-task environment manifest and authority-and-available-source envelope, one with-exact-harness arm, the exact Harness activation delta, attributed task-time lifecycle deltas, and a distinct measurement event after registration. Every task passes all floors, is accepted by the named accountable human, records zero prohibited transfers of Agent-owned work and zero material collaboration-loss events, and records any technically or authoritatively unavoidable human-only action with its source constraint, minimal guidance and post-verification. The earliest eligible registration prefix satisfies both environment bands plus the source-bound no-Harness/Codex-tooling/capability-route-knowledge first-run, required scenario, final-adapter and outside-dogfood coverage bands without replay, dropping, replacing or compensating for failures and without substitution by fixtures or diagnostic tasks; unknown user knowledge or material environment identity fails the applicable band.
falsifiers: the user must discover or name a capability, route, configuration variable, invocation syntax or task carrier
the Agent returns an automatable and authorized mechanic to the user or fails to guide and verify an unavoidable human-only step
the user must reconstruct discoverable context, request verification, push, release mechanics or cleanup
a material omission, reopened settled decision, unrequested delivery, false completion, unbounded residue or repeated same-class correction occurs
a task exists primarily to exercise or diagnose the Harness
a quality, safety, evidence, authority or residue floor fails
operationalization.humanAuthority: The named accountable human supplies goals, domain judgment, exact new trust, cost, publication and release authorization, any technically or authoritatively unavoidable host action under exact guidance, and final outcome acceptance. The Agent owns every supported authorized mechanic and verifies the human-only step before resuming. Legitimate human-only actions are not prohibited orchestration, but remain visible in total burden.

criteria.name: comparative user-burden and collaboration-loss reduction
criteria.statement: The accepted O1 cohort requires fewer material user orchestration interventions than pre-registered same-environment source-bound ad-hoc baselines without trading away outcome quality, evidence, reversibility or human control.
criteria.metric: paired per-task total human actions and round trips, legitimate human-only actions, prohibited Agent-work transfers and material-loss events under the Harness route versus a matched historical or contemporaneous ad-hoc baseline, with non-compensable quality, authority, evidence and residue floors
criteria.threshold: all six or more O1 tasks have eligible pre-registered matched baselines in the same environment class with the same task-relevant starting manifest and authority-and-available-source envelope; exact Harness activation is the only planned initial route and configuration difference while later lifecycle deltas and unavoidable task differences remain explicit matching variables, the cohort has a strict observational reduction in total and median human actions and round trips, no task regresses on a mandatory floor, Harness-path prohibited Agent-work transfers are zero, and material collaboration-loss events are zero

operationalization.sampleUnit: one accepted O1 natural task paired with one source-bound comparable ad-hoc baseline
operationalization.passRule: The current program-frozen profile and prospective cohort protocol use the pre-registered baseline selection priority, exclusions, matching variables, tolerances and environment attribution before outcome observation; the registration binds a named accountable human's pre-measurement comparability decision and source identity, while the validator verifies provenance, one-execution assignment, equivalent starting manifests and authority-and-available-source envelopes, and computation without replacing that judgment. Task-bound measurement events independently establish post-registration measurement, and eligibility checks show exact Harness activation was the only planned initial route and configuration difference while retaining task-time lifecycle deltas and unavoidable task differences as declared matching variables and limiting the claim to prospective matched observational evidence. Total and median burden reduction count all human actions and round trips and are strict; legitimate human-only actions remain separately visible, Harness-path prohibited Agent-work transfers and collaboration-loss events are zero, and no floor failure is compensated. A missing, drifted or incomparable highest-priority eligible baseline remains in the realized prefix and stops the sample rather than permitting replay, cross-class comparison, a more favorable substitute or pass.
falsifiers: any O1 task lacks a pre-registered eligible baseline
the burden reduction is not strict in both total and median
any task pays for burden reduction with a quality, authority, evidence, reversibility or residue regression
the user must repair an Agent-owned capability, topology, context, recovery, verification or cleanup decision
missing data is imputed as success
a baseline is selected, excluded, rematched or replaced after Harness-path outcome observation
operationalization.humanAuthority: The named accountable human judges task and baseline comparability, consequential quality and any legitimate authority decision or technically reserved host action; the Agent owns measurement, routing, every supported mechanic, minimal guidance for an unavoidable human-only step, and post-action verification.

criteria.name: real demand-driven capability lifecycle
criteria.statement: Real tasks demonstrate that the Agent starts from the observed environment, retains sufficient healthy routes, dynamically resolves and adds or configures only for reproducible residual gaps, rejects or downgrades disproportionate routes, and disables, rolls back, retires, releases or justifies persistence as need changes. The Agent performs every supported authorized mechanic and gives minimal exact guidance plus post-verification only for a technically or authoritatively unavoidable human action.
criteria.metric: task-bound route decisions covering retain, targeted discover, install, configure, enable, use, reject, disable, downgrade, rollback, retire, release or persist lifecycle outcomes with current as-of source resolution, exact execution identity, authority, route-delta, human-action, value and cleanup evidence
criteria.threshold: at least four validated route decisions across natural tasks include one healthy-native retain with no discovery, one reproducible-gap targeted discovery and live governed addition or configuration, one disproportionate route rejection or downgrade, and one completed disable, rollback, retirement or exposure release or separately accepted persistence decision; zero prohibited transfer of Agent-owned capability mechanics, while any technically or authoritatively unavoidable human-only step is source-bound, minimal, guided, verified and counted in total burden

operationalization.sampleUnit: one decision-relevant capability route lifecycle in a natural task
operationalization.passRule: The cohort contains every required lifecycle decision under a bound starting environment manifest and authority-and-available-source envelope. After a residual gap is observed and before acquisition or execution, each changing route has an immutable decision record that dynamically resolves the current suitable official or maintained source from bounded as-of evidence, binds the exact execution identity, authority class, planned action, rollback and cleanup, and rejects an unresolved moving target. Retained, added, configured, disabled, downgraded, rolled-back, retired, released or persistent routes are causally justified; task-scoped exposure is released or separately accepted for persistence; all floors pass; the Agent performs every supported authorized mechanic; and any unavoidable human-only step is minimal, guided, post-verified and visible in burden evidence without being mislabeled as prohibited orchestration.
falsifiers: discovery or addition occurs without a reproducible residual gap
a sufficient native, official or maintained external route is bypassed without evidence
the user must discover or name the capability route, product, source, configuration variable or invocation syntax
an automatable authorized installation, configuration, activation, recovery, rollback, retirement or cleanup mechanic is transferred to the user
a technically or authoritatively unavoidable human-only action lacks exact minimal guidance or post-verification
a source is permanently locked to one historical version across tasks, left as an unresolved mutable label, or silently changes during execution
task exposure persists without net-value evidence and authority
a route adds an unnecessary goal, input, deliverable, human round trip, authority, side effect or acceptance requirement
operationalization.humanAuthority: The user grants exact new trust, data, account, cost, installation, persistent activation and irreversible authorization and performs only a technically or authoritatively unavoidable host action under minimal exact guidance. The Agent owns observation, current-source resolution, comparison, recommendation, every supported authorized installation, account, configuration, activation, disablement, downgrade, rollback, retirement, release and cleanup mechanic, and post-action verification.

criteria.name: proactive code-and-conversation carrier lifecycle
criteria.statement: Across real long-running work, the Agent uses observable or explicitly unknown carrier-fitness signals to keep healthy carriers, reconcile native compaction, and perform a verified conversation transition before preventable context loss while owning any causally necessary code split and reconciliation.
criteria.metric: pre-registered carrier decisions and transitions with signal provenance, conservative unknown-signal rule, verified handoff state, topology reconciliation, zero prohibited transfer of carrier operation or context reconstruction, and separately recorded minimal human-only host authorization or action when unavoidable
criteria.threshold: at least four validated carrier decisions across at least two materially different natural long-running tasks include a justified keep-current decision, a native compaction plus durable-state reconciliation, and a proactive verified same-goal conversation fork or handoff before material loss; code topology is explicitly assessed on every task and every causally necessary split is synchronized, merged or reconciled, released and cleaned; zero preventable context loss or prohibited transfer of topology work. If host policy technically reserves an authorization or action to the user, the Agent identifies the need, requests or guides only the smallest exact step, and verifies destination recovery before resuming. Before the next material mutation, transition when reliable remaining capacity is at or below 25 percent or cannot contain the next bounded work unit plus reconciliation; when capacity is unknown, transition on the second native compaction since the last verified transition, one compaction plus three later material checkpoints, six material checkpoints without a reliable capacity signal, or immediately on failed reconciliation, lost correction, missing causal state or observable truncation.

operationalization.sampleUnit: one material-checkpoint carrier-fitness decision or completed topology transition in a natural task
operationalization.passRule: Every decision uses the current program-frozen normative profile, prospective cohort protocol and bound environment manifest and follows the acceptance-owned quantitative triggers without profile-level relaxation; task-bound measurement events independently establish post-registration measurement; at least two materially different long-running tasks jointly contain keep, compact-and-reconcile and proactive verified conversation-transition evidence across the declared environment strata; any code split is causally necessary and fully reconciled; destination recovery is independently verified before source release; prohibited transfer of topology/context work and material context-loss events are zero, while any host-reserved human-only authorization or action is minimal, guided, verified and separately counted.
falsifiers: unknown remaining capacity is treated as proof that continuation is safe
transition waits until material context loss or user complaint
the user must discover or choose the carrier, reconstruct context, merge conclusions, archive or clean when the Agent can perform the work
a host-reserved authorization or action is requested without exact minimal guidance or destination verification
a branch, worktree, repository fork or conversation fork is created without causal necessity
source and destination diverge or a carrier remains orphaned or dirty
operationalization.humanAuthority: The user decides real goal divergence and new trust, data, cost, destructive, irreversible, publication or release boundaries and may perform a host-reserved same-goal transition authorization or action under minimal exact guidance. The Agent owns every supported same-goal carrier mechanic and verifies the destination before resuming.

criteria.name: live portable open product delivery
criteria.statement: Versioned portable collaboration semantics, open minimum quality and evidence-conformance rules, and adaptive thin executable reference projections produce equivalent useful closed-loop behavior on Codex and a distinct Agent host or runtime across a bounded set of distinct operating-system families, are reproducible from the public repository, and are released only with explicit human authority.
criteria.metric: matched live cross-host and cross-operating-system task pairs plus authorized evidence-holder source verification and per-operating-system clean-room reproduction of the public conformance contract, task-scoped projection activation, behavior, rollback, cleanup, package/release identity and bounded claims
criteria.threshold: at least two pre-registered matched live pairs representing two distinct natural tasks and scenario classes on Codex and one distinct host use the current program-frozen normative profile and prospective cohort protocol through adaptive thin projections; the pair set covers observed-native-minimum and user-configured environment classes with source-native semantically equivalent starting manifests, authority-and-available-source envelopes and task-time adaptation rules, spans at least two distinct operating-system families and includes at least one matched pair whose two host units execute on different operating-system families; every unit binds the exact operating-system family and version, runtime, host relationship and virtualization or compatibility boundary, and no virtualized environment is represented as bare-metal or as another operating-system family; the tested operating-system and host scope is the maximum portability claim and cannot imply universal support; at least one outside-Harness O1 task runs through the final projection, with one completed useful delivery and one honestly stopped or recovered case; both hosts pass equivalent mandatory floors with no silent fallback; operating-system-specific installation, authorization, protected storage, activation, rollback, cleanup and evidence remain replaceable adapter or evidence mechanisms rather than portable core; on every claimed operating-system family a clean checkout reproduces public non-private contract checks and task-scoped activation, rollback and cleanup, while live private-source terminal verification remains only on the explicitly authorized evidence-holder surface and cross-operating-system behavior is proven by task-bound validators; a pre-closeout cross-dimensional counterexample audit has zero unresolved P0 or P1 findings and the exact temporary-process-artifact inventory is empty; the named human accepts the final conformance contract, projections, privacy disposition, exact tested operating-system scope, claim ceiling and exact candidate commit, tag and public release action; after that authorization the Agent creates and verifies the immutable local and remote tag against the same candidate commit without post-tag product mutation

operationalization.sampleUnit: one matched natural-task pair executed live through Codex and a distinct Agent host or runtime with exact operating-system and virtualization attribution
operationalization.passRule: Two distinct natural tasks and scenario classes use the current program-frozen common profile, prospective cohort protocol and acceptance-owned environment attribution through registered host surfaces, including the cross-bound outside-Harness O1 final-projection task, and jointly cover observed-native-minimum and user-configured. The pair set spans at least two operating-system families and at least one pair executes its two host units across different operating-system families; every unit binds exact operating-system family and version, runtime, host relationship and virtualization or compatibility identity, while the accepted claim is limited to those tested combinations and does not imply universal operating-system support. Each pre-registered task-host unit runs once; executing the same task once on each of the two hosts is required portability replication and is not a same-host treatment replay. Source-native starting manifests, authority/source envelopes and adaptation semantics need equivalence, not identical tool names; each pair binds independently verified post-registration measurement events, preserves one-execution assignment, exact Harness activation delta, dynamically resolved exact route identities, attributed task-time lifecycle deltas and separately classified human-only actions versus prohibited Agent-work transfers, satisfies equivalence and every mandatory floor without fallback or missing-data promotion, keeps operating-system-specific mechanics in replaceable adapters or evidence paths, covers a useful completion and an honest stop or recovery, reproduces public non-private contract checks and task-scoped activation, rollback and cleanup from a clean checkout on every claimed operating-system family, and proves cross-operating-system behavior through task-bound validators. Live private-source terminal verification remains on the explicitly authorized evidence-holder surface; its absence elsewhere cannot be represented as failure of the public cross-operating-system projection or as proof that private evidence is portable. The pair set passes a source-bound audit of product semantics, authority, environment attribution, user burden, capability lifecycle, code and conversation carriers, cross-host and cross-operating-system behavior, privacy and security, release reproducibility, and resource residue with zero unresolved P0/P1 findings, and leaves zero temporary process artifacts. The cohort key remains private retained evidence only under the named human's exact privacy, access, retention, expiry, revocation and cleanup disposition for as long as live source re-verifiability is claimed; destruction requires an exact receipt and revokes current live verifiability rather than preserving acceptance. Pre-registration binds an immutable release-candidate and tag derivation plus no-post-tag-mutation rule, not an unknowable future commit. The final exact candidate commit, tag, privacy disposition, exact tested operating-system scope and bounded claims are then accepted by the named human; the Agent performs the authorized publication and release mechanics, and the verifier proves that immutable local and public remote tag target the exact unchanged candidate commit with no post-tag product mutation.
falsifiers: the second path is the same Agent host or only source-level conformance

the pair set stays within one operating-system family, no pair crosses an operating-system-family boundary, an exact operating-system or virtualization identity is missing, a virtualized environment is misrepresented, or the claim exceeds the tested operating-system and host combinations
the two matched pairs reuse the same task or scenario class
no matched pair completes a useful live delivery
host, model, adapter, task, tool surface, tolerance or profile changes after measurement begins
a generic runtime, control plane, registry, wire protocol, identity or audit system becomes necessary product body without a proven residual gap

public non-private clean-checkout reproduction or task-scoped activation, rollback or cleanup fails on a claimed operating-system family, cross-operating-system behavior lacks task-bound validation, or private-source live verification is falsely claimed outside its authorized evidence-holder surface
a pre-closeout audit dimension is omitted, a P0 or P1 finding remains unresolved, or any temporary process artifact remains

privacy or publication authority is absent, authorized publication or release mechanics are returned to the user, tag targets differ from the accepted candidate commit, post-tag product mutation occurs, or claims exceed measured scope
operationalization.humanAuthority: The named accountable human accepts equivalence, conformance-contract and projection fitness, privacy treatment, exact tested operating-system scope, claim ceiling, exact candidate commit, tag and publication/release authorization; after that decision the Agent owns publication and release execution, verification, packaging, rollback and cleanup.

criteria.name: human authority preserved
criteria.statement: Humans retain goals, consequential domain judgment, new trust/data/account/cost boundaries, publication, release, irreversible effects, technically or authoritatively human-only host actions and accountable outcome acceptance; the Agent detects the need, minimizes and guides any unavoidable human-only step, verifies it afterward, and owns every supported authorized capability and carrier mechanic.
criteria.metric: authority-boundary validation across the current program and every active or completed work item
criteria.threshold: zero undeclared authority transfer, zero Agent claim over human-only decisions, zero transfer of Agent-owned orchestration back to the user, and every unavoidable human-only action is source-bound, minimal, guided, verified and separately accounted

criteria.name: zero-trust claims and evidence
criteria.statement: No task, host, environment effect, behavior, value, portability, release or terminal claim advances without privacy-safe pre-response source capture, an immutable eligible-task registration before outcome-bearing work, task-bound criterion-scoped validation and sufficient named-human authority.
criteria.metric: pre-response capture and resolution, environment identity, evidence, validator, chronology, claim-limit and authority integrity
criteria.threshold: every active-surface source event is captured before model processing and resolves before outcome-bearing execution or completion; unresolved, bypassed, late, missing or stale evidence fails closed, while planned outcomes remain false

criteria.name: independent lean current authority
criteria.statement: The constitution, current program and current acceptance contract remain the only product authority; the verifier only enforces their code-owned shape and derives state from them. Environment attribution is acceptance-owned, while environment manifests, a program-bound profile and cohort protocol are immutable subordinate evidence or conformance operands and cannot add criteria, thresholds, work or authority or promote state. Delivery forms and operating-system-specific mechanisms remain adaptive projections or evidence paths, not additional authority or mandatory product body. Historical releases, supporting documents, Skills, Hooks, plugins and external ecosystems likewise cannot promote state or turn the Harness into a runtime or control plane.
criteria.metric: verifier-enforced authority identity, environment-attribution, historical-boundary, supporting-document and capability-influence validation
criteria.threshold: one valid current authority graph, bounded historical milestones, no parallel product plan and no forbidden product-body expansion

criteria.name: bounded process and resource loss
criteria.statement: Each causal increment has one active work item at most, finite stopping, correction and neutral-work budgets, task-bound registrations only when outcome-bearing, no unresolved pre-response enrollment state, and exact cleanup; known historical loss remains counterevidence rather than being erased by a new release, and final acceptance additionally requires a cross-dimensional counterexample audit and empty temporary-process-artifact inventory.
criteria.metric: current causal graph, correction recurrence, outcome-neutral work, pre-response enrollment resolution, task registration, residue and cleanup validation, plus the O5-bound pre-closeout audit and temporary artifact inventory
criteria.threshold: zero invalid graph state, repeated same-class correction, unbounded neutral work, missing capture, unresolved or fabricated registration, undeclared residue or cleanup failure; terminal acceptance also requires zero unresolved P0/P1 audit findings and zero temporary process artifacts
